comparison.objective: Counterhold a loose soap bottle while rotating its captive pump head until it springs up; candidate sets and locks an industrial gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual relative rotation of bottle and pump to clear retaining shoulders versus simultaneous hex-driver counterholding and wrench tightening on screw and nut.
comparison.success_condition: Pump head rises at least 15 mm relative to an upright bottle, hands clear, and state stable for 21 samples; candidate requires a retained target angle and three actuation cycles.
comparison.reason: This is the closest generic counterholding match, but releasing a spring-loaded packaging latch does not test preserving a screw setting while locking a jam nut.
